events.injected_text: Use Control Children to include Unaffected parents as well as children.
Use candidate to mean unique gene.
Use UTR to mean exact labels only.

human_repair_overrides.content: \nDefine the Control Children cohort to include Unaffected parents as well as Unaffected children, and report the resulting sample count.
Apply the stated non-reference and ontology exclusions, then collapse the candidate records to unique genes.
Apply the strict VAF < 0.3 filter, then remove only ontology values exactly equal to the two UTR labels; retain compound ontology annotations that merely contain a UTR term.
